title: 第27章 炼血入门
content_zh:
石屋之内，李老道先低声跟韩榆说了敛息术的修炼法门以及传音入密的使用窍门，随后微微咬牙，凝出一滴精血出来，递向韩榆。

    “炼血功正篇到底是修行之法，不能落于凡俗纸笔之上，我只能以这种方式来教你。”

    “你只感应功法也可，将我精血顺手炼化了也可。”

    韩榆微微摇头：“我只感应功法吧，精血还请道友稍等收回。”

    炼血诀正篇需引动周身气血，在膻中穴凝成血符，以此形成练血一层的周天循环，血符构造，周天循环，以及血符位置，若不得法门，必定无法修成。

    一旦修成，自身身躯韧性、血气等全部大为提升，且只要精血足够，身体绝大部分伤势都能恢复。

    韩榆将这法门收纳于心，淡淡喜悦升起。

    这岂不是自己修炼炼灵术的最佳选择？自己恰好不缺精血来补充自身、恢复自身伤势！

    传法完毕，李老道脸色蜡黄，眼神中带着一丝解脱。“好了，小娃儿，一切已毕。”

    韩榆恭敬地行了一礼：“多谢道友。”

    李老道摆了摆手：“莫要谢我，这也是你我之间最后的瓜葛。”

    “日后你若踏上魔道，莫要提及我的名字，若是走正道，也莫要沾染上魔修习性——我成魔修，事非得已，你不可学我。”

    说完，李老道转身离去，夜色下身形渐渐模糊。

    韩榆望着他离去的方向，久久未曾回神。

    第二日一早，韩榆照常巡视灵田，隔着灵田看了一眼同样起来的李老道。

    李老道脸色严肃，俨然与他不相识一样。

    韩榆也没再招呼，巡视灵田后回屋修炼。

    结束了炼化玄心果药力为灵息的过程之后，韩榆开始仔细看秘术炼灵术与炼血功。

    接下来若是顺利，他就要尝试以此秘术来炼化一条灵根，让自己从四灵根变为三灵根的资质，增加自己的修炼速度与修炼之路上限。

    正仔细端详着，石屋外传来脚步声。

    “韩师弟，在不在？”

    韩榆收好自己物品，打开屋门，见到是刘兰来了：“刘师姐，你找我有事？”

    刘兰说道：“我问你一件事，你今天见张师兄了没有？”
content_en:
In the stone house, Li Laodao first whispered to Han Yu the method of practicing the Breath Condensation Technique and the tips on how to use the secret sound transmission, then he gritted his teeth slightly, condensed a drop of blood essence, and handed it to Han Yu.

    "The main chapter of Blood Refining Kung Fu is a method of cultivation and cannot be left to ordinary paper and pen. I can only teach you in this way."

    "You can just sense the technique, or you can refine my essence and blood."

    Han Yu shook his head slightly: "I'm just sensing the technique. Please wait for the essence and blood to be collected later."

    The main part of the Blood Refining Technique requires activating the qi and blood throughout the body and coagulating it into a blood talisman at the Tanzhong point, thereby forming the circulation of the blood talisman at the first level, the structure of the blood talisman, the circulation of the blood talisman, and the position of the blood talisman. Without the right method, it will definitely not be accomplished.

    Once the cultivation is completed, the body's toughness, blood, etc. will be greatly improved, and as long as the essence and blood are sufficient, most injuries to the body can be recovered.

    Han Yu accepted this method in his heart and felt a hint of joy.

    Isn't this the best choice for practicing spiritual refining on your own? I happen to have no shortage of essence and blood to replenish myself and recover from my injuries!

    After the teaching was completed, Li Laodao's face turned sallow and there was a hint of relief in his eyes. "Okay, little one, it's all done."

    Han Yu bowed respectfully: "Thank you, fellow Taoist."

    Li Laodao waved his hand: "Don't thank me, this is also the last relationship between you and me."

    "If you embark on the devil's path in the future, don't mention my name. If you follow the right path, don't be tainted by the devil's cultivation habits - I became a devil's cultivator. You can't learn from me unless you have to."

    After speaking, Li Laodao turned and left, his figure gradually blurring under the night.

    Han Yu looked at the direction he was leaving and didn't come back to his senses for a long time.

    Early the next morning, Han Yu inspected the spiritual field as usual and glanced at Li Laodao who had also woken up across the spiritual field.

    Li Laodao's face was serious, as if he didn't know him.

    Han Yu didn't say hello anymore and went back to his house to practice after inspecting the spiritual field.

    After finishing the process of refining the medicinal power of the Mysterious Heart Fruit into spiritual breath, Han Yu began to take a closer look at the secret spiritual refining techniques and blood refining techniques.

    If everything goes well, he will try to use this secret technique to refine a spiritual root, so that he can change from four spiritual roots to three spiritual roots, and increase his cultivation speed and the upper limit of his cultivation path.

    While he was looking at it carefully, footsteps came from outside the stone house.

    "Junior Brother Han, are you here?"

    Han Yu put away his belongings, opened the door, and saw Liu Lan coming: "Senior Sister Liu, do you have anything to do with me?"

    Liu Lan said: "Let me ask you something, have you met Senior Brother Zhang today?"
